info.title: NAVAS / OLIWA — new endpoints
info.description:
The endpoints added in this round: Waswa AI and its review console, a client's own team and audit trail, the geofence alert engine, and the changed fields on geofences, track playback, profile and alert rules.

Every call carries `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` from POST /users/auth, except the public ones (sign-in, refresh, password reset, payment callbacks, images). Internal services send `X-Service-Key` instead.

Bodies use the app convention `{"data": {...}}`. Replies are always `{status, message, data}`.
